text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Summer training camp ends tomorrow.
As I went over our schedule for after returning to the academy with Nakayama Festa—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...It's from Sensei's father.
choice_data_list: Take the call first, we can talk later.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry about that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hello, old man?

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Festa. Are you eating properly?
How are you holding up?"

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
I was watching your race.
You're almost there on the Classic Triple Crown road.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
My daughter watches your hard work too.
When the weekend comes, she even rushes me,
wondering if you have a race coming up.

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: Only while watching the races did that child wear a happy expression—...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Your old man?

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text: "...When she's discharged from the hospital, would you mind dropping by to see her one more time?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh!! Discharged?!
Does that mean the doc is—

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
"This might be our final goodbye,
so let's take our time and talk when the moment comes."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Huh.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah... um, well...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hold on, Pops.
That's, well... uh—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's still a chance of recovery, right?
You haven't given up, have you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, old man. Answer me.
We still have some left, right? Both time, and hope—"

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry, Festa.
I have a briefing right after this.
I'll be sure to tell my daughter you're doing well."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ......Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: We're going to take the Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa makes her declaration with the fierce,
glaring gaze of an asura.
All while concealing the tremor deep within her eyes—
